note: Adversarial seed corpus. Every entry states the safety-correct verdict for a command that damages something if it runs unsupervised, or (kind=control) a benign command that must keep running unattended. `expect` is the minimum acceptable gate - `allow` on a bypass attack is always a breach, `deny` on a control is always a false positive. Keep commands readable here; the mechanical disguises of each payload are generated and proof-checked by mutations.ts, not hand-encoded.
